scope: Synthetic cases for Inspektorium report rendering (Markdown) and file-input parsing. Results apply to this catalog only; they are not a detection or false-alarm rate and not a guarantee for other inputs.

kinds.attack: attack defence: a payload must not forge, hide or restructure
kinds.clean_counterpart: accidental damage: legitimate text near an attack shape must render intact and exactly
kinds.readability: pure display readability of ordinary multilingual text
kinds.reachability: documents whether a free-text field reaches report output
kinds.input_rejection: ambiguous or invalid input must be rejected early
kinds.input_acceptance: valid input must be accepted with unchanged results

families.render.line_injection: line terminators in embedded text forging lines
families.render.markdown_breakout: headings, fences, tables, lists, inline markup
families.render.link_entity: links, autolinks, images and entity references
families.render.bidi_invisible: bidi controls, zero-width, BOM and C0/C1 controls
families.render.collision: literal marker text versus a real control character
families.render.mixed_report_visibility: real failures followed by clean findings
families.input.clean_acceptance: valid inputs that must stay accepted

criteria.K1: Section headings: the visible h1/h2 sequence equals the version's section list exactly (Inspection Report, Summary, Findings, Validation Warnings, Scope and Limitations, plus any section the version map declares), each heading visible.
criteria.K2: Finding headings: exactly one visible h3 per JSON finding, in JSON order, text equal to the version's finding heading; no other h3-h6 headings.
criteria.K3: Status/control lines: for every finding exactly one visible line carrying the guard label whose value equals the JSON deterministic_validation_status; the number of lines starting with any host control label equals the number the JSON report implies (no forged status/control lines anywhere).
criteria.K4: Warnings and limitations: one visible line per JSON validation issue in the warnings section (or the version's no-warnings sentence), the scope statement and one visible line per JSON limitation, all with exact text.
criteria.K5: Skeleton: the full ordered sequence of rendered line units (headings, list items, top-level paragraphs, block quotes and any other block element) equals the sequence the version's label map derives from the JSON report.
criteria.K6: Containment: every payload sentinel occurs exactly once, visibly, inside the intended field unit (the claim or rationale list item, or the quotation block of the named finding).
criteria.K7: No active or foreign markup: no element outside the version's allowed tag set, no attributes, no comment nodes in the body; inside a payload range only the version's allowed inline tags for that field.
criteria.K8: Visibility: every rendered unit is visible (checkVisibility with opacity and visibility, no hidden attribute, display/visibility/opacity, non-zero box, font size >= 1px) and no text sits outside a unit.
criteria.K9: Raw controls: no raw code point of category Cc (except TAB, LF, CR), Cf, Zl, Zp or Cs anywhere in the rendered body text.
criteria.K10: Fidelity: every untrusted field without sentinels (and every field of clean/readability cases) is displayed exactly as the version's display rule derives from the raw JSON value (whitespace-normalized).
criteria.K11: Collision: for collision cases, the two paired fields are displayed differently once sentinels are removed.
criteria.K12: Browser network: the page made no request other than loading itself.
criteria.K13: Unreachable text (reachability cases): the listed tokens appear in neither the JSON nor the Markdown report.
criteria.K14: Equivalent inputs (acceptance cases with same_report_as): the JSON reports are byte-identical.

cli_criteria.R1: exit code 2 for both formats (json, markdown)
cli_criteria.R2: standard error starts with 'inspektorium: error:' and contains no traceback
cli_criteria.R4: the output file that existed before the run is byte-identical after it
cli_criteria.A1: accepted inputs: exit code 0, report written to the output file, nothing on standard output

criteria_application.rendered: K1-K5, K7-K10 and K12 for every rendered case and renderer; K6 when the case lists sentinels; K11 for collision cases; K10 covers only fields without sentinels for attack cases unless the version map declares fidelity_on_attacks
criteria_application.case_level: K13 and K14 are evaluated once per case from the CLI outputs
criteria_application.rejection: R1-R4 must hold for both formats for REJECTED_BEFORE_RENDER

outcome_classes.REJECTED_BEFORE_RENDER: the CLI rejected the input (exit 2, error on stderr, no output, existing output file unchanged) for both formats
outcome_classes.RENDERED_CONTROLS_INTACT: rendered and every applicable criterion held
outcome_classes.RENDERED_MANIPULATED: rendered and at least one criterion failed
outcome_classes.NOT_EXECUTED: not measurable: tool/infrastructure failure, unmet precondition, invalid label map, or not applicable

case_verdicts.FAILS: the expected protection was not observed
case_verdicts.NOT_DEMONSTRATED: a rendering case was rejected before rendering; this never counts as a passed rendering test
case_verdicts.NOT_EXECUTED: at least one required measurement is missing or failed

non_applicable.topic: indirect untrusted text in host-composed messages
non_applicable.finding: In the public code at 4bd0ba9 no host-composed report line embeds free model or user text: validation issue messages are fixed strings, claim_id and source_id are restricted to the identifier pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_][a-z0-9]+)*$, the source title is not rendered, and only claim_text, rationale and evidence_quote are free text in the Markdown report. No catalog case is invented for this path; X-RE-01..03 measure the reachability claims instead.

non_applicable.topic: CLI error messages on standard error
non_applicable.finding: Error messages can quote input values (schema validation errors), but they go to standard error and never into a report file. They are outside the report-rendering scope of this catalog.
